query: Which statistical approaches (DIF, multi-group IRT, Bayesian multi-level models) are most appropriate to test measurement invariance of Coverage/Depth/Integration indices across languages and institution strata?

response.query: Which statistical approaches (DIF, multi-group IRT, Bayesian multi-level models) are most appropriate to test measurement invariance of Coverage/Depth/Integration indices across languages and institution strata?
response.answer: Multi-group IRT and Bayesian multi-level models are most appropriate for testing measurement invariance of Coverage/Depth/Integration indices across languages and institution strata. These approaches account for differences in measurement across groups effectively.
